The topology mask shows a clean separation, suggesting no major background bleeding, but this does not negate the internal texture issues.

Additionally, the handler's hand exhibits fusion/distortion artifacts (severity ~2.0). The image also suffers from general compression/low-resolution blur (severity ~0.4 per PQ auditor), which exacerbates the texture loss. These issues compound to lower the artifact score significantly below 4.0.
